data.narrative:
Antares is a Series C nuclear energy company founded by Jordan Bramble and Julia DeWahl that has raised $470M to date. The nuclear energy sector comp universe includes 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms, though a narrow peer set of same-stage or similar-tier comparables remains limited.

A stage-progression methodology is applicable here, using total raised as a value proxy and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C progression to subsequent funding rounds. This method yields $799M. A peer-median approach using narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, similar-tier) could not be applied; while 6 nuclear energy peers exist, none of the filtered subsets met the minimum threshold of 3 comparable datapoints required for meaningful triangulation. Broadening to all-sector medians would introduce material distortion given sector-specific capital intensity and technology risk in frontier nuclear.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $679M to $919M, with a median point of $799M. This range reflects reliance on a single methodological leg; the primary uncertainty is the absence of sufficient granular peer comparables at Antares' stage and tier within nuclear energy. Additional valuation confidence would require either expanded private market datasets from nuclear specialists or closer public market guidance from the thin comp set.
